scores.label: A
scores.note: 'recognize' is the strongest; 'understand', 'see', 'grasp', 'become aware' usable. Options 4, 5, 7 add 'that', giving ungrammatical 'understand that how many' (0). Option 8 'made me know how many' is unidiomatic (0). Option 10 'made me learn how many' is unidiomatic and shifts sense (0). Several near-copies with and without 'that'.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Every option is in the past tense, so after 'made me' each needs a tense edit; capped at usable. Option 1 'realized' repeats the forbidden word (0). Option 2 'knew' -> 'made me know' is unidiomatic even after the edit (0). Option 9 'learned' -> 'made me learn how many' unidiomatic (0). Option 10 'took to heart' is ungrammatical in place and shifts meaning (0).
